title: Podcast Prepare Clip
description: Resolves one clip of an analysed episode (an analysis candidate, a Prompt Director candidate, a saved edit version, or explicit start/end) into a render-ready plan: extracts the interval, aligns word timestamps with faster-whisper, snaps the boundaries to word edges, plans filler/pause edits with safety rules (smart / cut / mute / keep, per-cut restore), fits the duration to the requested target (natural / strict / maximum — never through a word) and writes analysis/clips/<id>/plan.json + compliance.json. The plan goes out on the text lane (for podcast_layout / podcast_render) and, when a video listener is wired, a small copy of the clip goes out on the video lane for the stock frame grabber + pose estimator (phase 2 layouts). Chat context lines: 'project:', 'clip:', optional 'start:', 'end:', 'title:', 'captions:', 'layouts:', 'fillers:', 'silences:', 'duration:', 'mode:', 'version:', 'restore:', 'layout: auto|solo|stacked|screen|full|original', 'subject: p2'.
